summary.offshell_bosonic_tables: engine B evaluated at every bosonic row of engine A kernels_C2.json (AV|AV: AV, AV AV, AW AW, AsV c; AV|AW: AW, AV AW, AsW c; AW|AW: AW AW; 24 rows, C_{P_beta} and C^0_Delta): exact agreement, log2/log3 coefficients included, iff A's vertex-vertex sign kappa = -1; kappa = +1 fails on every row with a nonzero vertex-vertex part
summary.kappa_resolution: kappa = -1 (engine A convention VV_b); in the leg sets AsV c, AsW c A has letter part = vertex-vertex part (pure log2, log3) and B gives 0, consistent only with kappa = -1
summary.third_method: QA momentum-space Taylor expansion with exact tensor reduction and radial integrals, own Feynman rules from Ch1/Ch3 and the kernel form of Lemma lem:cc-kernels (i); one overall factor F0 = -hbar/2 (sign of the odd skeleton) fixed once; predictions: (AV,AW)->AW at both A points (C_Pb, C^0) and its eps^-1 pole (= B symbolic pole), GC3 (-1/3, -8/3 per colour word), AW|AW off-shell table (2 points), twist two S' <= 4 at generic complex null momenta: P7 (c) and P7 (b) along n and along generic b: all exact
summary.harmonic_action: independent implementation of [B03c] (4.27)-(4.29): every spectral target of Prop prop:cc-targets and Table tab:cc-su11 reproduced; engine D_1 matrices at theta = -1/3 equal -8 x (H12 + H21) at matrix level in the engines' bases (twist two S'<=4, fermion S'<=5, gluon S'<=2, (F11,psi) S'<=4)

entries_static.engine_A: With sector-dependent theta the two-field part sees only the sectors of its leading letters; the gauge completion (A|_V letters, sector V) enters the three-field part, so gauge covariance of D_1 couples theta_V to theta_perp, theta_lambda (Conjecture P7 (a), not tested here).  Translation-covariant scheme: thetaP = theta, P_1 = D_1^b / 2.

engine_B.statement: on every family computed (two-field shell, cohomology): sum C2_{P_b} = -(1/3) u d_b and sum C2^0_Delta = -(2/3) u N, so
engine_B.D1_position_part: (D_1)^b = 2 sum C2_{P_b} - 2u sum_a theta_{diamond(a)} d_b X_a = -2u sum_a (1/3 + theta_{diamond(a)}) d_b X_a
engine_B.D1_translation_invariant: D_1^0 = 4 lc^natural + sum_a u(c_phi - 2 theta_{diamond(a)} w_a) X_a - (2/3) u N = 4 lc^natural - 2u sum_a (1/3 + theta_{diamond(a)}) w_a X_a (c_A = 2/3, c_lambda = 1/3, sum_a (c_phi + (2/3) w_a) = (2/3) N); kappa_V, kappa_lambda terms s-exact, zero on the shell
engine_B.Xi_Delta: -u sum_a (1/3 + theta_{diamond(a)}) v.|_{letter a}; equal theta: -(1/3 + theta) u {S^(1)(Delta),-}
engine_B.arity_two: position part exact (Thm thm:cc-arity2) and d_b O not exact on these families => theta_perp = theta_lambda = theta_V = -1/3 on every family with letters of that sector (F1: theta_perp; F2 fermion: theta_lambda; F3 gluon: theta_V; mixed families: all), D_1 = 4 lc^natural
engine_B.P1: P_1 = sum C2_{P_b} - u sum_a theta^P_{diamond(a)} d_b X_a = -u sum_a (1/3 + theta^P_{diamond(a)}) d_b X_a (+ kappa^P terms, s-exact); translation-covariant scheme theta^P = theta = -1/3: P_1 = 0 (Cor cor:cc-theta (iii)); equal theta^P: P_1 = u(theta - theta^P) d_b at theta = -1/3
engine_B.two_component: D_1 = -8 u E_H = (g^2 N/(4 pi^2)) E_H on eigenstates; P_1 = -(1/3 + theta^P) u b_m d_m, -(1/3) u = g^2 N/(96 pi^2)

entries_static.note: identical statements: D_1 = 4 lc^natural - u sum_a (1/3+theta_a) v.X_a, P_1 = -u sum_a (1/3+theta^P_a) d_b X_a
